schema.encoding: plain JSON, one combined file for every source (fetch once client-side, filter by holding symbol)
schema.refresh: hourly, every day (see zenserve's scripts/cron_publish_news.sh) -- merged into what's already on disk, not a full replace; see this module's docstring

item.stocks: array of NSE trading symbols this item is actually about (regex-matched on symbol + company name in title/summary); empty array for general market news not tied to a specific constituent
item.time: ISO 8601 UTC (trailing 'Z'), the source's own published time
item.title: string
item.sourceLink: string, canonical article URL -- the de-dupe key across runs

schema.note: Trimmed to the last 4 days and at most 1500 items on every publish run. Universe tagged is the current Nifty 100 (see src/eod/universe.py's fetch_nifty100_constituents); a holding outside that index never gets a 'stocks' match here, though the item itself is still kept (empty 'stocks' array) if a source published it. A separate, never-trimmed archive of every item ever seen lives at internal/news_archive/news.jsonl -- not fetched by the app, not part of this schema.
